title: HACP Secure SecureEnvelope/v1
description: Wire object for HACP Secure payload protection. Handshake kinds (hello, ack) carry ephemeral X25519 keys, random nonces, and an Ed25519 signature over the labeled transcript. Data kind (msg) carries ChaCha20-Poly1305 ciphertext under per-session, per-direction keys with the sequence number as AEAD nonce, plus a REQUIRED per-message Ed25519 signature over (AAD || ciphertext) for third-party attribution. AAD = canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace) of the header with 'ct' and 'sig' removed. 'contract' is the TIER-2 binding: the frozen HACP contract revision digest ('sha256:' + 64 lowercase hex), or the empty string for pre-contract bootstrap traffic.

kind.description: hello = initiator handshake; ack = responder handshake; msg = protected data.

from.description: Claimed sender agent URN. Authenticated via handshake signature + pinned key (hello/ack) or via AEAD + per-message signature (msg).

contract.description: TIER-2 binding: frozen HACP contract revision digest, or empty string for pre-contract bootstrap traffic (the propose/accept messages that create the revision cannot be bound to it). MUST be the empty string on hello and ack — handshake signatures do not cover it and sessions span the contract lifecycle; only msg kinds carry the TIER-2 value.

sid.description: Secure session id: 16 bytes, lowercase hex, derived in the key schedule and bound to the HACP session id. Present on ack and msg; TIER-1 binding.

seq.description: Per-direction monotonic sequence number starting at 0. Doubles as the AEAD nonce input (0x00000000 || u64be(seq)). Present on msg.

epub.description: Sender's ephemeral X25519 public key, 32 bytes lowercase hex. Present on hello and ack. Never reused across sessions; identity keys never perform DH.

nonce.description: Sender's random 32-byte handshake nonce, lowercase hex. Present on hello and ack.

sig.description: Ed25519 signature (64 bytes, lowercase hex). hello/ack: over the domain-labeled handshake transcript ('HACP-SECURE/v1/hello' | 'HACP-SECURE/v1/ack' prefix). msg: REQUIRED, over ('HACP-SECURE/v1/msg' || AAD bytes || ciphertext bytes) — domain-separated for third-party attribution; no prefix-less signing input exists. Present on all kinds.

ct.description: ChaCha20-Poly1305 ciphertext concatenated with the 16-byte Poly1305 tag, lowercase hex. Minimum length covers the tag for empty plaintext. Present on msg.

ts.description: Optional advisory RFC 3339 timestamp. Never used in replay or authentication decisions.
